hero.title: Capture the web. On your terms.
hero.subtitle: A growing suite of browser extensions to snap web pages, save AI chats, and summarize product reviews, all saved locally or synced where you work.

products.subtitle: Each one does a single job, and does it well.

web-snapper.name: Web Snapper
web-snapper.tagline: Save any web page, all of it, or just the parts you choose.
web-snapper.description: Capture full pages or selected regions and save them to local files. Highlight, annotate, and take notes right on the page, then keep everything organized.
web-snapper.feature1Desc: Grab an entire page or select exactly the content you want to keep.
web-snapper.feature2Desc: Mark up pages with highlights, notes, and annotations as you read.
web-snapper.feature3Desc: Export to local files so your captures are always yours.

ai-chat-snapper.name: AI Chat Snapper
ai-chat-snapper.tagline: Turn your AI conversations into documents you own.
ai-chat-snapper.description: Save chats with AI assistants as Word, PDF, HTML, JSON, or Markdown. Keep them on your device or sync them straight to Notion and Google Docs.
ai-chat-snapper.feature1Desc: Export to Word, PDF, HTML, JSON, and Markdown.
ai-chat-snapper.feature2Desc: Send conversations to Notion, Google Docs, and more.
ai-chat-snapper.feature3Desc: Never lose an important AI conversation again.

review-snapper.name: Review Snapper
review-snapper.tagline: Understand what shoppers really think at a glance.
review-snapper.description: Pull user reviews from product pages, then summarize and compare sentiment so you can make buying decisions faster and with confidence.
review-snapper.feature1Desc: Gather user reviews from supported shopping sites.
review-snapper.feature2Desc: See aggregated sentiment and compare products side by side.
review-snapper.feature3Desc: Cut through the noise and buy with confidence.

Footer.tagline: Powerful browser extensions for capturing, saving, and understanding the web.
